tool.name: Manhattan Plot Generator
tool.description: Creates a Manhattan plot from association results

param.name: results_file
param.label: Association Results File
param.help: The output file from the Association Test tool.

param.name: pval_thresh
param.label: Significance Threshold (P-value)
param.help: P-value for the genome-wide significance line.

param.name: top_n
param.label: Number of Top Hits to Report
param.help: The number of most significant SNPs to save in the output table.

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool generates a Manhattan plot, the standard visualization for a Genome-Wide Association Study (GWAS). It plots the statistical significance (-log10 of the p-value) for each SNP along its genomic position.
This allows for easy identification of SNPs that are most strongly associated with the trait being studied.
**Inputs**
- **Association Results File:** The main results table generated by the Association Test tool (Tool 3).
**Outputs**
- **Plot (PNG):** An image of the Manhattan plot. - **Top Hits (tabular):** A table listing the N most statistically significant SNPs from the analysis.
